description: This file defines the configuration state and parsing logic for TalkMode Gateway settings in a macOS application. It includes the data structure 'TalkModeGatewayConfigState' and a static parser 'TalkModeGatewayConfigParser' for extracting configuration values from a snapshot, with fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Struct representing the current configuration state for the Talk Mode Gateway.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses configuration snapshot to produce a talk mode gateway configuration state, considering defaults and environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a fallback configuration state with default values and environment overrides.
